components.name: Solid Button
components.description: Primary action: ink rectangle; hover draws the cobalt selection frame with square handles.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:3.9rem;padding:0 2.25rem;background:#1A1916;color:#fff;font:600 1.15rem 'Work Sans','Heebo',system-ui,sans-serif;border:0;cursor:pointer;} .ds-btn-solid .ds-sel{position:absolute;inset:-5px;border:1px solid #2354E6;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;pointer-events:none} .ds-btn-solid i{position:absolute;width:9px;height:9px;margin:-4.5px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #2354E6;opacity:0;transform:scale(.3);transition:opacity .15s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1)} .ds-btn-solid i:nth-of-type(1){left:-5px;top:-5px} .ds-btn-solid i:nth-of-type(2){right:-5px;top:-5px} .ds-btn-solid i:nth-of-type(3){left:-5px;bottom:-5px} .ds-btn-solid i:nth-of-type(4){right:-5px;bottom:-5px} .ds-btn-solid:hover .ds-sel,.ds-btn-solid:focus-visible .ds-sel{opacity:1} .ds-btn-solid:hover i,.ds-btn-solid:focus-visible i{opacity:1;transform:none} .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible{outline:none}

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Secondary action: white rectangle with a 1.5px ink border.
components.css: .ds-btn-line{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:3.9rem;padding:0 2.25rem;background:#fff;color:#1A1916;font:600 1.15rem 'Work Sans','Heebo',system-ui,sans-serif;border:0;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px #1A1916;} .ds-btn-line .ds-sel{position:absolute;inset:-5px;border:1px solid #2354E6;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s;pointer-events:none} .ds-btn-line i{position:absolute;width:9px;height:9px;margin:-4.5px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #2354E6;opacity:0;transform:scale(.3);transition:opacity .15s,transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1)} .ds-btn-line i:nth-of-type(1){left:-5px;top:-5px} .ds-btn-line i:nth-of-type(2){right:-5px;top:-5px} .ds-btn-line i:nth-of-type(3){left:-5px;bottom:-5px} .ds-btn-line i:nth-of-type(4){right:-5px;bottom:-5px} .ds-btn-line:hover .ds-sel,.ds-btn-line:focus-visible .ds-sel{opacity:1} .ds-btn-line:hover i,.ds-btn-line:focus-visible i{opacity:1;transform:none} .ds-btn-line:focus-visible{outline:none}

narrative.overview:
The page is a white canvas, like the one in a design tool. The work sits on it: a sculpted and painted bust, clay icons, colored pencil and paper. The interface stays plain so the objects can be seen.

The site looks like the tools it was designed in, and the objects look like they were made by hand. That is the position: craft and code are one practice, not two portfolios side by side.

Headings are heavy capitals set tight. Everything else is quiet: one hairline, one blue. Nothing on a page explains itself. Project pages keep their own palettes (Better Eater green, Giuson navy, Kindred orange); the site around them does not change.

Rejected on purpose, and not to return: a red accent, halftone or dotted lettering and shapes, a 3D name, and a star as contact decoration.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink type, one cobalt accent.
Heavy uppercase display type; plain Work Sans for reading.
Square controls with no icons or arrows; hover selects them like a layer.
Clay-and-paint objects as the only decoration.
Clay arrow pointer, cobalt over empty space and pink over anything clickable.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is the only accent. It marks what you can select, hover or focus. Red was removed on purpose; do not bring it back.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: Text is #1A1916, not #000. Black appears only inside project work and video.

rules.name: The Capital Voice Rule
rules.body: Only headings are heavy capitals. Running text stays ordinary so it can be read.

rules.name: The No Dots Rule
rules.body: Lettering is solid. Halftone and dotted type were removed because they cost legibility and clash with the clay.

rules.name: The Flat Canvas Rule
rules.body: A control never lifts. Hover and focus are shown by the blue selection frame, not by shadow.

dos: Do use Selection Cobalt (#2354E6) as the only accent, and show hover and focus with the thin blue frame and corner handles.
Do set all headings in Work Sans 800 uppercase with tight tracking, and let body copy stay ordinary.
Do keep controls square and label-only.
Do let clay and paint objects, clips and project pictures carry the personality.
Do keep real, plain wording and real numbers; keep every interactive state reachable by keyboard.
donts: Don't use red anywhere on site chrome.
Don't use halftone or dotted lettering, arrows, shapes or sparkles.
Don't bring back the 3D name, or put a star in the contact section.
Don't put explanatory micro-copy inside interfaces; keep rationale on one quiet page.
Don't put a small label above a heading as an eyebrow, and don't use rounded pills for actions.
